# Bundled nlohmann/json

This directory contains the single-header distribution of nlohmann/json 3.12.0,
pinned from the upstream `v3.12.0` release. It is used only when CMake cannot find
a suitable system `nlohmann_json` package or when
`CXX_MODGRAPH_USE_BUNDLED_NLOHMANN_JSON=ON` is selected.

The upstream project is licensed under the MIT license; see `LICENSE.MIT`.
